text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C at large gains felt rewarding, but gains relative to my purchase price alone do not determine whether I should sell; I should consider each holding’s role and the portfolio as a whole.","My recent purchases of B, C, D and E have not yet shown a clear outcome. I should not add to positions merely because prices have fallen or hold them just to avoid admitting a mistake.","A few months of account changes provide no reliable signal about what prices will do next. I should make measured decisions based on my risk tolerance and diversification rather than reacting to short-term moves."]}
